author: GPT-6 Astra (Grudgelands)
paths_relative_to: manifest directory; source paths relative to repository
count_note: 60 strips cover all 24 family/weapon combinations and three extra bow draw stages per bow family, in two variants.

animation.timing_scope: family, shared by both variants and all weapons/stages

ember.motion: A short flame grows upwards and subsides; one spark rises and fades.

rime.motion: A fixed ice crystal forms, holds its glint, then fades with cold mist.

bulwark.motion: A silver-blue glint travels once along a cutting edge, then rests.

ruin.motion: A fixed red-hot edge beats twice like a heart; one ember lifts away.

mercy.motion: Warm gold-white light breathes slowly; a single soft mote rises.

reckoning.motion: A hard gold-white flash and crimson point punctuate a long still pause.

quarry.motion: A short teal breeze or a single green leaf drifts away, then rests.

veil.motion: A narrow violet-black wisp rises and thins beside a fixed silver edge.
